# Reset: use a simpler permutation test
n_permutations = 10000
chi2_perm = []

# For each permutation, shuffle the channel labels and recompute chi2
for _ in range(n_permutations):
    shuffled_channel = np.random.permutation(sales_df['channel'].values)
    shuffled_table = pd.crosstab(shuffled_channel, sales_df['customer_segment'])
    
    # Ensure the table has the same shape
    if shuffled_table.shape != contingency_table.shape:
        continue
    
    shuffled_observed = shuffled_table.values
    shuffled_expected = np.outer(shuffled_table.sum(axis=1), shuffled_table.sum(axis=0)) / shuffled_table.sum()
    
    # Avoid division by zero
    chi2_val = np.sum((shuffled_observed - shuffled_expected) ** 2 / (shuffled_expected + 1e-8))
    chi2_perm.append(chi2_val)

# Compute p-value
p_value = np.mean(np.array(chi2_perm) >= chi2_stat)

print(f"Chi-square statistic (observed): {chi2_stat}")
print(f"p-value (permutation test): {p_value}")"}
